title: The Horn That Divided the World Cup

sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: Every four years, dozens of football teams from around the world,
sentences.zh: 每隔四年，来自世界各地的数十支足球队，

sentences.en: that's the soccer kind of football for our American listeners,
sentences.zh: 对于我们的美国听众来说，这就是美式足球以外的那种足球，

sentences.en: gather for a time-honored tradition, the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 会聚在一起参加一项历史悠久的传统赛事——世界杯。

sentences.en: And every four years, millions of football fans from around the world
sentences.zh: 同样每隔四年，来自世界各地的数百万足球迷

sentences.en: gather for another time-honored tradition, being mad at the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 会聚在一起参加另一项历史悠久的传统——对世界杯感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Partly they're mad at the opposing teams, that's the fun kind of mad.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是对对手生气，这是那种有趣的生气。

sentences.en: But they're also mad at FIFA, the nakedly corrupt organization that runs the tournament.
sentences.zh: 但他们也对国际足联感到愤怒，这个公开腐败的组织管理着这项赛事。

sentences.en: This year, the main reason to be mad at FIFA is for outrageous price gouging.
sentences.zh: 今年，生国际足联气的最主要原因，是其令人发指的哄抬物价行为。

sentences.en: Their new dynamic ticketing system, along with their blatantly self-dealing resale market,
sentences.zh: 他们全新的动态票务系统，连同其明目张胆的谋私转售市场，

sentences.en: are causing ticket prices to skyrocket.
sentences.zh: 正在导致票价急剧飙升。

sentences.en: The most expensive seats for the previous World Cup final were $1,600.
sentences.zh: 上一届世界杯决赛最贵的座位是1600美元。

sentences.en: When the first round of tickets for this year's final went on sale,
sentences.zh: 当今年决赛的第一轮门票开始发售时，

sentences.en: the cheapest seats in the house started at a staggering $2,790.
sentences.zh: 全场最便宜的座位起步价就高达惊人的2790美元。

sentences.en: Then, they more than doubled in later rounds.
sentences.zh: 随后，在后面的轮次中，价格更是翻了两番多。

sentences.en: For those who missed the pre-sales, there's always FIFA's resale market,
sentences.zh: 对于错过预售的人来说，还可以通过国际足联的转售市场买票，

sentences.en: where they take a hefty 15% cut from both buyers and sellers.
sentences.zh: 他们在其中向买卖双方各抽取高达15%的巨额抽成。

sentences.en: Seats behind the goal for that final game were recently listed there for $2.3 million each.
sentences.zh: 那场决赛球门后面的座位最近在那里标价高达每张230万美元。

sentences.en: Last year also saw FIFA award a sycophantic peace prize to the sitting U.S.
sentences.zh: 去年，国际足联还向时任美国总统颁发了一项阿谀奉承的和平奖。

sentences.en: The lead-up to the 2022 tournament in Qatar had numerous human rights violations in the construction of the stadiums,
sentences.zh: 在2022年卡塔尔世界杯筹备期间，场馆建设中发生了大量侵犯人权的行为，

sentences.en: reportedly leading to the deaths of hundreds of migrant workers.
sentences.zh: 据报道导致了数百名外来劳工的死亡。

sentences.en: The cup before that was hosted by Russia in the wake of their annexation of Crimea.
sentences.zh: 再上一届世界杯则是在俄罗斯吞并克里米亚之后由其主办的。

sentences.en: And in 2015, 11 FIFA officials were indicted for accepting over $150 million in bribes.
sentences.zh: 而在2015年，有11名国际足联官员因接受超过1.5亿美元的贿赂而被起诉。

sentences.en: So, we thought we'd take you back to a comparatively quaint World Cup controversy from 2010.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们决定带大家回顾2010年一场相对来说还算小巫见大巫的世界杯风波。

sentences.en: Plastic horns that were just too dang loud.

sentences.en: In the spring of 2004, journalist Mark Gleason sat in the front row of a small conference room in Switzerland for a big announcement.
sentences.zh: 2004年春天，记者马克·格里森坐在瑞士一间小会议室的第一排，等待一项重大宣布。
现场气氛层层递进，充满戏剧性。

sentences.en: There was a lot of tension.
The winning bid to host the 2010 FIFA World Cup was about to be revealed, and South Africa was among the leading contenders.
sentences.zh: 2010年国际足联世界杯的主办权即将揭晓，南非是主要竞争者之一。

sentences.en: I mean, they had all the top guns go to Zurich for that particular announcement.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们把所有重量级人物都请到了苏黎世去听那场特定的宣布。

sentences.en: The former president of Clack was there.

sentences.en: South Africa wanted to be the first African nation to host the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 南非希望成为第一个举办世界杯的非洲国家。

sentences.en: They also wanted the tournament to be the start of a new chapter.
sentences.zh: 他们还希望这次赛事能够成为新篇章的开始。

sentences.en: During apartheid, the country was banned from the international sporting community.
sentences.zh: 在种族隔离期间，该国被国际体育界禁止参加比赛。

sentences.en: Now, they were on the precipice of hosting soccer's biggest event.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们正处于举办足球最大盛事的边缘。

sentences.en: South Africans gathered in the streets of Johannesburg, Cape Town, and Durban to await FIFA's decision.

sentences.zh: 2010年国际足联世界杯将在南非举办。

sentences.en: You know, South Africa had come full circle in the sense of its horrible past and how it had moved on from being a pariah state
sentences.zh: 你知道，南非在经历了可怕的过去、摆脱了被孤立的状态之后，已经走出了一个完整的圆，

sentences.en: and was now, you know, hosting the biggest event in world sport and very much part of the international family.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道的，它举办了世界体育界最大的盛事，并且真正成为了国际大家庭的一部分。

sentences.en: The celebrations that erupted that day in Zurich were full of cheers and whistles,
sentences.zh: 那天苏黎世爆发的庆祝活动充满了欢呼声和口哨声，

sentences.zh: 但也有一个臭名昭著的声音，成为了南非世界杯的标志。

sentences.en: Back in 2004, nobody really talked about Vuvuzelas.
sentences.zh: 早在2004年，没有人真正讨论过呜呜祖拉。
